summary: Constrain dirty snapshot paths and publish handoff success only after lease replacement

delivery.outcome: Fix reproduced porcelain parsing, staged-index path validation, complete snapshot byte accounting and false handoff-success publication. Publish material139 through realCI and independentApp. Remove repeated immutable fixture preparation costs so unchanged full validation can complete inside existing stage limits.
nonGoals: No new takeover authority or automatic reclamation/timeout ownership transfer
No controller/foreign lease effect outside synthetic tests
No policy, model, SDK, CI/default300, max-snapshot or complexity-cap changes
No consumer-managed patch, device OTA, PyPI enrollment or foreign-cache cleanup

architecture.decision: Bounded repair of four reproduced defects across two existing pathname readers and one existing takeover module. Keep legacy successful trace shape, all owner/fencing/policy checks and all limits. Prepare an explicitly nonauthoritative recovery record before lease mutation, publish success only after accepted matching bytes; never execute a production takeover in this task. Existing idle tool is shipped by managed standard only, not part of governance-only pip bundle; synchronize only the two existing bundled readers. Digest malformed/unsafe path observations disable cache; no new validation or ownership authority. Existing snapshot cap includes tracked diff and complete archive bytes. An ignored prepared transaction binds exact before/after lease hashes; final success trace shape remains compatible. Scope amendment under continued execution authorization: existing validation fixtures use a checked once-per-process report schema while validating every report, and local clones borrow read-only immutable Git objects with separate worktrees/indexes/refs. No cases, assertions, stage commands, CI/default300 limits or production behavior are removed or changed;15 material paths remain inside the existing15-file/3-component budget.
interfaceChanges: Governance dirty-state cache digest consumes both pathname records for R/C in either status column and refuses unsafe observations without reading outside.
Existing ignored idle-handoff storage gains nonauthoritative prepared recovery data; successful returned/final trace records retain their existing shape.
architecture.rollback: Independently reviewed revert; retain immutable138 and consumer pins.

validation.evidence: Actual RM and synthetic R/C matrix, content invalidation, invalid filename bytes and unsafe parent cases through both readers; malformed observations disable cache.
Track diff, files and archive framing obey unchanged cap; lease/journal fault injections produce no false success and leave exact recovery state; existing positive/lock/CAS/frozen behavior retained.
Staged regular bytes remain authoritative despite working-tree symlinks/missing files; staged symlinks, unsafe syntax and working-tree escapes remain refused in both readers.

Native gate, all canonical/default300 and fulltests, actualLinux/Windows/OneDev, exact independentApp then immutable139 before done. Existing103 work-admission/bootstrap tests and11+18 follow-up tests retain exact coverage after fixture preparation optimization; full Goal tests cover all bootstrap variants.
